dependencies.exposure: Extreme — China imports over 70% of its iron ore; Australia accounts for roughly 62% of that, Brazil roughly 21%. Crucial input for steel production.
dependencies.alternatives: Limited. The Simandou project in Guinea is ramping up but remains logistically bottlenecked and years from meaningful scale.
dependencies.source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: Rare earth elements (NdFeB magnets, gallium, germanium, antimony)
dependencies.exposure: Asymmetric near-monopoly — China controls an estimated ~68% of mining and ~90% of global rare-earth refining/magnet processing.
dependencies.alternatives: 5-8 year lag estimated for alternative processing capacity to scale in Australia (Lynas) and the US (MP Materials).
dependencies.source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: S-400 spares, Su-30MKI parts, nuclear submarine leasing, T-90 fleet spares
dependencies.exposure: Operational exposure — an estimated 36-40% of India's military inventory remains of Russian legacy/design origin.
dependencies.alternatives: Domestic production (India's 'Make in India'/IDEX programs), diversification toward France (Rafale, Scorpène submarines) and the US (GE F414 jet engines).
dependencies.source: SIPRI Trends in International Arms Transfers, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), solar cells, electronics intermediate goods
dependencies.exposure: Industrial exposure — India imports an estimated ~68% of its bulk drugs/APIs and over 70% of its photovoltaic cells from Chinese suppliers.
dependencies.alternatives: India's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes are accelerating domestic capacity, but medium-term dependency persists.
dependencies.source: World Bank WDI 2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: Advanced lithography tools (EUV/advanced DUV), EDA design software
dependencies.exposure: Technological chokepoint — export denial of tools below the 7nm process node slows indigenous advanced AI chip fabrication.
dependencies.alternatives: Domestic Chinese lithography (SMEE) is estimated to lag 2-3 process-node generations behind, with reliance on legacy nodes (28nm and above) for now.
dependencies.source: WTO Global Trade Outlook 2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: Liquefied natural gas (LNG) and pipeline gas
dependencies.exposure: Post-Russian transition — near-total replacement of Russian pipeline gas with US/Qatari LNG and Norwegian pipeline gas since 2022.
dependencies.alternatives: Long-term supply contracts are now locked in, but spot-price volatility exposure remains meaningfully higher than under the old Russian-pipeline arrangement.
dependencies.source: EIA Monthly Energy Review 2025-2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.exposure: Critical — over 80% crude dependency on Gulf exporters, shipped through both Hormuz and Malacca.
dependencies.alternatives: Strategic petroleum reserves cover an estimated 90-120 days; essentially zero domestic geological substitutes exist for either country.
dependencies.source: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025/2026, via user-provided unified research

dependencies.commodity: Machine tools, microelectronics, optics, drone components
dependencies.exposure: Sanctions-circumvention dependency — crucial for sustaining Russia's domestic military-industrial output since 2022.
dependencies.alternatives: Limited: North Korea (munitions) and Iran (drone engines/technology) are the main alternative sources, at much smaller scale than China.
dependencies.source: SIPRI Trends in International Arms Transfers, via user-provided unified research
